releases.summary: Navbar, API docs, and popularity chart fixes.
changes: Fixed the mobile navigation menu appearing behind the API reference panel.
Removed the Sources page and merged its content into the About page.
The opening popularity chart now scrolls horizontally on small screens, with wider spacing between years.
Fixed a scrollbar flicker when hovering points in the opening popularity chart.
API responses are no longer cached too aggressively by the browser.
The Learn more and API cards now navigate in the same tab, with an external-link icon on links that open a new tab.

releases.summary: Performance and interface cleanup across the site.
changes: Fixed the top openings endpoint returning an error.
Pre-rendered the opening boards as static images so the openings page loads instantly.
Rewrote the About page as plain, readable text.
Redesigned the Explore cards and unified card styling across the site.
Added the base layout with navigation and footer.
Launched the overview page with dashboard and explore sections.
Set up the core charting and data-visualization components.
